authenticity_review: The image exhibits high visual fidelity with realistic lighting, shadows, and fur texture. The purple coloration is rendered convincingly without banding or unnatural gradients. Minor artifacts noted by the Router include slight fusion between the mid-sections of the two horses and soft definition at the hooves where they meet the grass. These are subtle and do not significantly detract from the overall realism. The SAM mask confirms coherent boundaries for the main subjects.
key_defects: Slight boundary fusion between the two horses in the chest/mid-body region.
Hooves lack crisp definition and appear somewhat soft/melted into the grass.
